26 27 ## What is Paperclip? 28 29 # Open-source orchestration for zero-human companies 30 31 **If OpenClaw is an _employee_, Paperclip is the _company_** 32 33 Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track your agents' work and costs from one dashboard. 34 35 It looks like a task manager — but under the hood it has org charts, budgets, governance, goal alignment, and agent coordination. 36 37 **Manage business goals, not pull requests.** 38 39 | | Step | Example | 40 | ------ | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | 41 | **01** | Define the goal | _"Build the #1 AI note-taking app to $1M MRR."_ | 42 | **02** | Hire the team | CEO, CTO, engineers, designers, marketers — any bot, any provider. | 43 | **03** | Approve and run | Review strategy. Set budgets. Hit go. Monitor from the dashboard. | 44 45
46 47 > **COMING SOON: Clipmart** — Download and run entire companies with one click. Browse pre-built company templates — full org structures, agent configs, and skills — and import them into your Paperclip instance in seconds. 48 49
